lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five identifiable horizontal rows and six visible vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroids of the high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring a light upper edge and a shadowed lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, irregular high-luminance blobs is visible on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin.
